title: Canadian Noodle Dish
description: A simple and flavorful Canadian noodle dish made with lightly seasoned noodles and your favorite protein.

ingredients.name: Vegetables (such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli)

instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add vegetables and cook until tender.
Add soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add cooked noodles to the pan and stir-fry until combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
